findings.title: Massimo turns Vraska tokens and Spree spells into a repeatable engine
findings.summary: A repeat Massimo brewer and follow-up discussion connect Vraska's spell-triggered creature tokens to Massimo's bind ability. Multiple discussions also converge on one-mana Spree cards, especially Great Train Heist, because their additional costs remain payable when Massimo recasts them.

notes: The brewer linked a maintained paper list and described Great Train Heist as a principal win condition.
The token engine and Spree rules interaction were explained mechanically rather than merely named.

corroboratingSources.name: Massimo. What the hell do we do with this?
corroboratingSources.creator: r/EDH contributors

alternatives.name: Vraska tokens as immediate mana
alternatives.reason: Without haste, Vraska's creature Treasures cannot tap immediately, and sacrificing a token carrying a bound spell loses that spell.

alternatives.name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
alternatives.reason: Kykar supplies evasive tokens and can convert Spirits to mana, strengthening the Great Train Heist line.

reasons: Low current popularity leaves room for genuine discovery.
The relationship has tested or maintained deck evidence.
Recent movement suggests the idea is gaining attention.
